scratchProbe.what: a temporary suite src/lib/api/__tests__/zzU88ScratchProbe.test.ts that ran parseCampaignIntent (src/types/campaign/campaignSyncSchemas.ts:141-146) on an AllocateSalvage intent whose recoveredUnit carried unitRef, unitSource and sourceVersion 3, and wrote the parsed result to a scratch file named by an environment variable; deleted right after the run (git status afterwards shows no such file)

nonClaims: No live server was driven: no npm run build, no npm start, no browser, no Playwright. The route was exercised only through the jest harness (handler called with a plain req/res pair, auth mocked, temp SQLite database). What a UAT tester sees is not proven by this receipt.

In the jest harness getDefaultMatchStore() returned the InMemoryMatchStore (its dev-only warning prints in the logs; getDefaultMatchStore.ts:68-79 picks DurableMatchStore only when shouldUseDurableStore(), production). The durable store production uses was not run; read only, DurableMatchStore.ts:736 writes meta with JSON.stringify and :1331 reads it back with JSON.parse and a cast, no schema.
The server-restart path that rebuilds a co-op host from stored meta (CampaignHostRegistry.ts:365-382 getOrCreate) was not exercised.

The host was registered with campaign journal authority off (checked in the suite's beforeEach), so the creation checkpoint ran without its genesis step; the journal-authority arm was not run with this body.

The body is built with buildCampaignAuthoritativeState exactly as the panel calls it, but the panel component itself was not rendered with real stores (its own suite mocks the builder, CampaignCoopEntryPanel.test.tsx:56-58).
Rows cover a canonical roster unit only; a custom unit (unitSource 'custom') carrying sourceVersion was not posted.
No production writer of a sourceVersion that is 0, negative, fractional or a string was searched for beyond the minting path the charter names (pinSourceVersion) and its two creation-page call sites.
npm install/ci/prune and lifecycle scripts were never run; the node_modules guard refused as the charter expects (admission receipt).
